title: British couple win £1,488 after using AI to fight housing eviction
summary_full: A British couple in their 70s who fought eviction from their home have won the right to recover £1,488 spent on an AI legal research tool. The High Court allowed the expense after finding that the subscription was purchased specifically to help them prepare their case without legal representation. The couple had challenged a housing association's electricity charges, which had formed the basis of possession proceedings.
